name: Apple Pro Mouse
notes: 50-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface (interface 0) of a real Apple Pro Mouse, from the usb-hid-device-report-corpus dump of the device: https://github.com/steve-chamberlin/usb-hid-device-report-corpus/blob/37179eb6d8c61847c27a6def827a9dce39bf608d/mice/05AC-0302 Apple Pro Mouse M5769, one button.txt#L57-L60. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
